events.title: FactSet analyst consensus raises ASPEED 2026 EPS median to NT$194.98; reported target price NT$22,500
events.analyst: FactSet consensus (17 analysts; individual analysts not identified in public article)

interpretation.note: Material consensus revision suitable for analyst reference/divergence diagnostics only; it must not directly change production Fair Value before deterministic evidence materialization and analyst-blend qualification.

events.evidence_summary: A public Cnyes article published at 08:10 on 2026-09-10 attributes a 17-analyst FactSet survey to a rise in the 2026 EPS median from NT$189.62 to NT$194.98 and reports a target price of NT$22,500, with 2027/2028 EPS and revenue consensus values also provided.
events.raw_fetch_reason: Persist the public source bytes and metadata, compute SHA-256, and, where legally/technically available, cross-check the underlying FactSet-derived values before promoting to production analyst evidence.
